items.q: What is MAX_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS set to, and who chose it?
items.answer: MAX_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS is set to 47, and it was chosen by the reliability team after the March incident.

items.q: What is the queue heartbeat interval in seconds, and what do
items.answer: The queue heartbeat interval is 17 seconds, and RFC-114 must be read before changing it.

items.q: What is the legacy token prefix string, and how long do old
items.answer: The legacy token prefix string is 'fci-v1-'. Old tokens (fci-v1-) expire after 30 days; new ones after 90.

items.q: What is the name of the deploy lock, and how many may exist
items.answer: The deploy lock name is `forge-deploy-global-lock`, and only one may exist cluster-wide.
